component.name: PDFinity
component.summary: Professional, modular, offline-first PDF productivity suite
component.developer_name: StackSync Solutions (Lead Programmer: Jake Ashley Panlilio)

description.p: PDFinity is an enterprise-grade desktop PDF application engineered in modern C++20 and Qt 6. Designed from the ground up for absolute document integrity, memory safety, and complete data privacy, PDFinity operates 100% offline with zero cloud accounts, zero telemetry, and zero hidden network transmissions.

Core capabilities include high-speed document viewing, lossless page assembly, annotation studio, interactive AcroForms filler, native content editing, PKCS#7 cryptographic signing, irreversible multi-pass redaction, offline OCR, format conversion, and scriptable batch automation.
PDFinity 0.1-Beta initial clean open-source release under Mozilla Public License Version 2.0.
